in_marathi.name: Dharitriya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharitriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dharitriya is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Dhari’, meaning ‘to hold’. This name is a reference to the Hindu goddess of the earth, Dharatri. It is believed that the goddess holds and nurtures all of creation.

This name is a reference to the Hindu goddess of the earth, Dharatri. It is believed that the goddess holds and nurtures all of creation.
